description: Find screenshots within max_distance (Hamming distance, default 3) of an integer perceptual hash (hash_type, default phash), each with scan, URL, title, distance and similarity score.

hash_type.description: Kind of perceptual hash: phash (default), ahash, dhash or whash.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

hash_value.description: Perceptual hash of a screenshot, as an integer.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

max_distance.description: Largest Hamming distance that still counts as similar, 1 to 10 (default 3).
max_distance.title: Max Distance

name: search_similar_screenshots
title: Search Similar Screenshots
